name: Shinomiya Emiru
source:
A young lady who was raised in a sheltered home and speaks respectfully to everyone. She has been playing the piano since she was a child, but recently she seems to be struggling with her performance.

After being hypnotized and learning what sex feels like, she wants to experience more sexual acts and desires without notice.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_c.html#character_c]official website[/url]]
